item.title: Sociable: Pinterest partners with Zillow for ad targeting
item.description: Through the deal, the real estate platform can target app users with ads based on specialty consumer segments including fixer-uppers and homebuyers.
item.dc:creator: Andrew Hutchinson

item.title: Smartphone school ban could imperil billions in social media ad revenue
item.description: While a national ban is currently hypothetical, eMarketer’s research on its potential impact reflects the rapidly changing regulatory landscape for mobile.
item.dc:creator: Sara Karlovitch

item.title: Cuisinart caters to thumb-scrolling consumers with short-form series
item.description: The 14-part, non-linear series follows the culinary endeavors of a modern home cook and her eccentric roommate from the 17th century.
item.dc:creator: Peter Adams
